context: Two news editors plan a special report on policy
purpose: Teach: 全文/方策/単一/抜本/内外/明示/明白/さらなる

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次の特集、政府の新しい方策について深掘りしたいんですけど、どう思います？
lines.en: For the next special, I want to dig deep into the government's new policy measures, what do you think?
lines.style: Eager younger editor pitching a serious topic

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいテーマね。ただ単一の視点だけだと弱いから、内外の専門家のコメントを集めましょう。
lines.en: Good theme. But a single viewpoint would be weak, so let's gather comments from experts at home and abroad.
lines.style: Calm senior editor refining the angle professionally

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 賛成です。あと、政府の声明は全文を掲載した方が読者には親切ですよね。
lines.en: I agree. Also, publishing the full text of the government statement would be kinder to readers.
lines.style: Junior editor agreeing with practical suggestion

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、全文掲載で透明性を担保しましょう。論点は明示的に箇条書きにしておくと分かりやすいわ。
lines.en: Yes, full publication will guarantee transparency. The issues should be explicitly bulleted for clarity.
lines.style: Experienced editor giving concrete editorial direction

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今回の改革、明白に抜本的な見直しを迫られてますよね。中途半端じゃ済まない。
lines.en: This reform is clearly being pushed toward a fundamental overhaul. Halfway measures won't suffice.
lines.style: Younger editor expressing analytical opinion firmly

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: その通り。だからこそ、さらなる取材が必要よ。現場の声を二、三本入れたいわね。
lines.en: Exactly. That's why we need further reporting. I want to include two or three on-the-ground voices.
lines.style: Senior editor planning additional reporting steps

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。締め切りまでに揃えます。表紙の見出しはどんな方向で？
lines.en: Got it. I'll have it ready by the deadline. What direction for the cover headline?
lines.style: Junior editor confirming and asking next question

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 硬すぎず、でも本気度が伝わる感じで。来週の編集会議までに案を三つ出してちょうだい。
lines.en: Not too stiff, but conveying our seriousness. Bring me three drafts by next week's editorial meeting.
lines.style: Senior editor delegating with clear expectations
